tools.label: rustc
tools.evidence: rustc --error-format=json exposes rendered message, optional diagnostic code, spans, and suggestions as separate fields; this corpus records capability only.

tools.label: miette
tools.evidence: miette is a Rust diagnostic rendering library: applications provide optional code, help, reason, and source spans; no application-independent code or edit result is assumed.

tools.label: Zig
tools.evidence: Zig compiler diagnostics expose source locations and rendered messages; there is no stable cross-release diagnostic-code contract in this descriptor.

tools.label: Go
tools.evidence: Go toolchain diagnostics expose source locations and rendered messages; this descriptor does not infer a stable diagnostic-code or machine-edit contract.
